code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    # Find a uniform separator that divides the grid into equal-sized panels.
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c == w - c - 1:
            split = ("v", c)
            break
    if split is None:
        for r in range(h):
            if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h - r - 1:
                split = ("h", r)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("no equal-panel separator found")
    axis, k = split
    if axis == "v":
        left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        right = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        left, right = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    # The shared background color is the only color common to both panels.
    bg = min(common, key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in left) + sum(row.count(x) for row in right))
    return [[3 if a == bg and b == bg else bg for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p.read_text())
